scope: First rank-8 VACE LoRA launch attempt on A800 GPU 4
summary: The attempt stopped before optimization because the remote helper encoded model paths as a comma string while the pinned DiffSynth revision requires a JSON array.
evidence: GPU preflight selected physical A800 GPU 4 with 81,225 MiB free.
The run recorded rank 8, four epochs, dataset repeat 2, 448x256x17, and learning rate 5e-5 before exiting with JSONDecodeError.
No checkpoint was produced and no training step ran.
lessons: Training command serialization must be verified against the exact pinned DiffSynth CLI before consuming GPU time.
The local helper already contained the JSON-array fix; the remote project copy was stale.
limitations: This attempt provides only launch diagnostics, not trainability or visual-quality evidence.
next_actions: Synchronize the fixed command builder to the remote project and relaunch in a new experiment directory.
